business_summary: NSK Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells industrial machinery bearings, automotive products, and precision equipment and parts worldwide. The company's products include ball bearings; roller bearings; bearing units; super precision bearings; bearings for steel industry, mining and construction, papermaking machines, and pumps and compressors; and bearings for special environments, including sanitary, corrosion-resistant, vacuum, cleanroom, high-temperature, non-magnetic requirement, and dust-contaminated environments. It also provides automotive products, which comprise chassis products, such as electric power steerings, steering column and intermediate shafts, brake systems, and hub unit bearings; electrification Products; and power train products comprising engine parts and electrical accessories, automatic and manual transmission, differential gear and propeller shafts, electrical accessories, engine parts, toroidal CVT POWERTOROS unit, and motorcycles and all-terrain vehicles. In addition, the company offers precision machine components, including ball screws, linear guides, monocarriers linear actuators, XY tables, and spindles; and accessories, including ball screw support bearings, air bearings, and clean grease, as well as support units for heavy and light loads, machine tools, and small equipment. Further, the company provides megatorque motors and maintenance services; and digital services comprising condition monitoring solutions through wireless vibration diagnostic device D-VibA10. It serves agriculture, automotive, cement, food and beverage, industrial motor and gearbox, injection molding machine, machine tool, medical device, mining and construction, motorcycle, office equipment, palm oil, papermaking machinery, pump and compressor, railway, semiconductor, steel and metal, sugar, and wind turbine industries. NSK Ltd. was incorporated in 1916 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: NSK Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 산업용 기계 베어링, 자동차 제품, 정밀 장비 및 부품을 전 세계적으로 제조 및 판매합니다. 이 회사의 제품에는 볼 베어링이 포함됩니다. 롤러 베어링; 베어링 유닛; 초정밀 베어링; 철강 산업, 광업 및 건설, 제지 기계, 펌프 및 압축기용 베어링; 위생, 부식 방지, 진공, 클린룸, 고온, 비자성 요구 사항 및 먼지로 오염된 환경을 포함한 특수 환경용 베어링입니다. 또한 전동식 파워 스티어링, 스티어링 컬럼 및 중간 샤프트, 브레이크 시스템, 허브 유닛 베어링과 같은 섀시 제품으로 구성된 자동차 제품도 제공합니다. 전기화 제품; 엔진 부품 및 전기 액세서리, 자동 및 수동 변속기, 차동 기어 및 프로펠러 샤프트, 전기 액세서리, 엔진 부품, 토로이달 CVT POWERTOROS 장치, 오토바이 및 전지형 차량으로 구성된 파워트레인 제품. 또한 이 회사는 볼 스크류, 선형 가이드, 모노캐리어 선형 액추에이터, XY 테이블 및 스핀들을 포함한 정밀 기계 부품을 제공합니다. 및 액세서리 포함
